===== PROMPT SAMPLE 1 =====
[Description]
Task: Generate a complete, compilable Java program for refactoring engine testing. The target refactoring operation is: move method. Output only the Java source code with no extra text, descriptions or explanations. The generated Java program must satisfy all requirements in the Conditions and Features sections. Do not introduce any redundant logic beyond the required features.

[Conditions]
    1. Source class name: SourceClass1
    2. Target class name: TargetClass1
    3. The method name to be moved: methodToBeMoved
    4. The method to be moved contains formal parameters of the TargetClass1 class type.
    5. The package name: test.move 

[Features]
- The nested class should have a method that calls the overridden method from the source class.
